record.question: What is called inquest conducted by lawyer, judge, doctor with legal qualification?
record.explanation: Answer A: Coroners inquest. A coroner’s inquest is a legal inquiry conducted under a coroner system; coroners may have legal or medical qualifications depending on jurisdiction. Source/context note: Coroner systems are not universal; in India, magistrate/police inquests have different statutory roles. Reference: https://www.britannica.com/topic/coroner. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
